tools.name: create_program
tools.description: Create or update the shop program: shop name, reward text, stamps required before a reward. Returns the program and its join URL (the poster target).

tools.name: stamp
tools.description: Add one stamp to a customer card. Identify the card by its 8-character code (from the customer page) or by its token. One stamp per card per day unless allow_multiple is true.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one customer card: how many stamps, what the reward is, whether it is ready to redeem.

tools.name: redeem
tools.description: Redeem the reward on a card that has reached its required stamps. Resets the stamp count and increments the rewards-earned counter.

tools.name: program_stats
tools.description: Program plus this month stamp usage and quota, so a shop can tell how close it is to the free limit.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_card" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
